description: Field initializers are the constructor's body, so a mark on the constructor is enforced against them and the throw is reported where it is written.

diagnostics.message: Call to `load` escapes this `@nothrow` function: its body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`, or make `load` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
